sloka: अथायान्तं हनूमन्तं ददर्शर्क्षपतिः पथि।वानरैः कृतसङ्ग्रामैः श्वसद्भिरभिसंवृतम् ।। ६.८३.५ ।।
transliteration: athāyāntaṁ hanūmantaṁ dadarśarkṣapatiḥ pathi।vānaraiḥ kṛtasaṅgrāmaiḥ śvasadbhirabhisaṁvṛtam ।। 6.83.5 ।।

translations.english: Then the Lord of Bears saw Hanuman accompanied by Vanaras who fought in war coming sighing.
